title: Measure Your Height Right
cut_style: polaroid photo cutouts held with colorful push pins
voice: Friendly, clear, brisk narrator, warm and encouraging, around 170 WPM.

cuts.wrong_height_setup: Simple flat illustration of a person measuring height at a wall while wearing shoes, with a tilted book above their head and a small red warning triangle; no text, no letters, no numbers.
cuts.morning_measure: Simple flat illustration of sunrise through a window above a bed, with a relaxed standing silhouette stretching gently nearby; no text, no letters, no numbers.
cuts.barefoot_wall: Simple flat illustration of bare feet with heels touching together at the base of a plain wall, toes forward; no text, no letters, no numbers.
cuts.flat_book_head: Simple flat side-view illustration of a head and upper back against a wall, with a book lying perfectly level on top; no text, no letters, no numbers.
cuts.weekly_mark: Simple flat illustration of a blank calendar sheet with a single colored dot, plus a pencil making a small wall mark beside a figure; no text, no letters, no numbers.

scenes.vo: You're probably measuring your height wrong.
Measure in the morning, before your spine compresses.
Stand barefoot, heels together, back against the wall.
Keep the book flat, not tilted upward.
Mark once weekly, same time and setup.
Get your personal routine in TallPlan.
